STRICT rules from jorap-voice:
- Max **200 characters** (count carefully; fail if over)
- MUST say link is in the comments ("link in comments" / "URL in the comments" / similar)
- **Must motivate the click** — name the payoff waiting on the site (the skip, the fix, the checklist, the pack method, the story beat) so scrolling past costs them something. Hook alone is NOT enough. "link in comments" alone is NOT enough. Vague "what stuck / full take / on my site" is NOT enough.
- One concrete hook from the post (scene, take, friction)
- Human JoRap voice: specific, uneven, plain words, contractions OK
- No AI bait: no "excited to share", "check out my latest", "game-changer", emoji, hashtags, "Thoughts?"
- No em dashes — use hyphen -

Good pattern: hook + specific payoff + link in comments
Example: "Viral tote drops keep missing me. I nest a BRATTBY in the medium FRAKTA - bag kit that beats the chase. How I pack it: link in comments."

Bad: "Viral tote drops keep missing me. Blue FRAKTA by the door. Link in the comments."

For each file: read frontmatter + first ~50 body lines. Rewrite only social_media_intro.

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{"filename.md": "new social_media_intro string"}
No markdown fences. Every string ≤200 chars.
